summary: Champions League matchday 2 dominates, with most favourites (Arsenal, Inter, Barcelona) trimmed toward slightly lower DraftKings fair prices and Leipzig/Atlético legs held at market after large news-driven line moves. Excluded legs cover games with unconfirmed key availability (McTominay, Slavia midfield, Sporting's Suárez/Maxi), Challenger/WTA 125 tennis and lower-tier Dota qualifiers.

verdicts.reason: UCL MD2 confirmed (ESPN); Arteta confirmed Hincapie and Zubimendi out with Saliba and Tzolis also absent (thefalse9, arseblog), Lille without Mbappe Lottin and Igamane (Sports Mole); DraftKings fair 0.786, about 2pp below market.

verdicts.reason: Chivu says Calhanoglu fine and Bastoni available with 'some changes' after Parma (Sky Sport Italia, MilanoSportiva); Stones out (Sports Mole); DraftKings fair moved 0.721 to 0.768 on that news, slightly below the 0.7765 market.
verdicts.main_risk: Light rotation plus Inter's poor recent UCL record (6 losses in 7) against a high-scoring Brugge leads to a draw.

verdicts.reason: Barcelona (9/9 in LaLiga, six straight wins) without Raphinha, De Jong and Christensen, keeper Joan García fit (COPE squad list, socblaugrana); Galatasaray near full strength with Osimhen in Turkish predicted XIs (halktv, aspor); DraftKings fair 0.735, ~3pp below market.
verdicts.main_risk: RAMS Park atmosphere and the pace of Osimhen and Leão exploit Barcelona's high line without Raphinha.

verdicts.reason: UCL MD2 confirmed (ESPN); PSV have no fit recognised striker (Pléa, Pepi, Lammers out per NOS/Bosz presser) while Leipzig beat Frankfurt 6-0; market already moved Leipzig from ~46% to 58% fair (DraftKings), Polymarket ~1pp above — no extra edge.
verdicts.main_risk: In-form PSV (20-6 goals in last five) win an open, high-press game; over 3.5 at -130.

verdicts.reason: PSV's striker crisis (NOS) already priced: DraftKings fair 1X 78.7 vs Polymarket 79.7; Leipzig miss only squad players Baumgartner, Guiu, Ouédraogo (club presser via Sportschau).
verdicts.main_risk: A PSV away win from Bosz's high-tempo side in a volatile game.
